requiredBehavior: Expose a capability-gated, bounded metadata/no-follow inspection operation whose result preserves unknown or unsupported platform states and cannot follow an untrusted path or symlink.
summary: Profile 0.18 provides bounded listing, entry names, kinds, mutation, and sync. The remaining filesystem gap is an explicit no-follow metadata query with file type, size, and symlink-safe inspection semantics.
title: No no-follow directory metadata inspection
